note: Content prompt ideas by phase. The coach turns one into a ready-to-edit draft for the owner to post. Never posted by the coach.

groundwork: Show a rough before and after of one thing you changed this week.
Share the one-sentence hook and ask which word grabs people.
Post a 10 second clip of the core action with no explanation.
reveal: Announce the store page with your best clip and the home base link.
Show the capsule art process from sketch to final.
Explain one design decision in three sentences.
grow: A short clip of a moment that surprised a playtester.
A bug that turned into a feature.
Ask players to choose between two options you are deciding on.
A small behind the scenes look at your workspace or tools.
A clip of the hardest part of the game.
showcase: Tell people the demo is coming and when.
The demo is live: where to play, what to look for.
A thank-you post with something you learned from demo players.
final_approach: Release date reminder with a fresh clip.
A short countdown post with one feature per post.
launch_window: Launch announcement with the home base link.
A thank-you to everyone who played on day one.
first_month: Answer the most common question from reviews.
Share a player creation or moment (with their permission).
long_tail: Sale announcement when you join an event.
Anniversary or milestone post with a look back.
